entities.name: CFAP58
observations: The 768-aa query is an exact 100% identity, full-query-coverage match to reviewed Chlamydomonas reinhardtii CFAP58 (UniProt A8HUA1).
A CFAP58 coiled-coil domain (PF21771.2) was detected at residues 363–657.
Mammalian CFAP58 homologs show functions in sperm flagellar axoneme assembly/organization and primary-cilium elongation; these functional roles are homolog-based inference for the query.

entities.name: Cilium assembly
observations: Reviewed mouse and human CFAP58 homolog annotations associate the protein with cilium assembly.

entities.name: Sperm axoneme assembly
observations: Reviewed mouse and human CFAP58 homolog annotations associate the protein with sperm axoneme and flagellum assembly and organization.

entities.name: Cilium-dependent cell motility
observations: The exact Chlamydomonas CFAP58 match is annotated to cilium-dependent cell motility; localization annotations include axoneme, motile cilium, and flagellum.
